convert_fullcell_to_halfcell_voltage: convert a full cell voltage value to half cell voltage vs SHE or RHE using calibration data
get_she_voltage: get the SHE voltage from a full cell voltage using the get_she function
load_calibration_data: load experiment calibration data for voltage conversion including measurements conditions and extracted params
convert_she_to_rhe: convert a SHE potential to RHE scale given pH and reference electrode potential
correct_potential_with_ir_drop: correct an electrode potential for IR drop and convert to RHE scale using current density and area
